inputs.xtext_rule_text:
NonOccurrenceUsageElement returns SysML::Usage :
	  DefaultReferenceUsage
	| ReferenceUsage
	| AttributeUsage
	| EnumerationUsage
	| BindingConnectorAsUsage
	| SuccessionAsUsage
	| ExtendedUsage
;

notes: The clause text has a blank line inside the alternation, before SuccessionAsUsage; it is layout, not a break in the production.
decision: SysML 8.2.2.6.4 states NonOccurrenceUsageElement : Usage = DefaultReferenceUsage | ReferenceUsage | AttributeUsage | EnumerationUsage | BindingConnectorAsUsage | SuccessionAsUsage | ExtendedUsage, and the SysML Xtext agrees (identical). The rule is the clause as written.

evidence.note: NonOccurrenceUsageElement : Usage = DefaultReferenceUsage | ReferenceUsage | AttributeUsage | EnumerationUsage | BindingConnectorAsUsage | SuccessionAsUsage | ExtendedUsage
